# shinyreact — Quick Reference

shinyreact is a bridge between Shiny's reactive graph and React. It ships zero UI components — it is pure plumbing for downstream packages (e.g. `shinyshadcn`) to build on top of.

Full details: see `llms-full.txt` in this repo.

---

## Two patterns

**`app.py` pattern** — Server describes UI as a JSON tree (`Node()`/`node()`). A registered component library renders it. Pick this when building a reusable component package.

**`ui.tsx` pattern** — Server holds only reactive data. Client is a full React app that calls Shiny hooks directly. Pick this for one-off app UIs where the client owns all layout.

---

## JS bundle contract (downstream component bundles)

1. Build as IIFE (not ESM/CJS).
2. Externalize `react` → `window.shinyreact.React`. Externalize `react-dom/client` → `window.shinyreact.ReactDOM`. **Do not externalize `react-dom`** — Radix/portal components need `createPortal` which only lives in `react-dom`, not `react-dom/client`.
3. Call `window.shinyreact.registerComponents(null, registry)` at load time.
4. Load after `shinyreact.js` (HTMLDependency ordering guarantees this).

```js
// vite.config.js for a downstream IIFE bundle
rollupOptions: {
  external: ["react", "react-dom/client"],
  output: {
    globals: {
      react: "window.shinyreact.React",
      "react-dom/client": "window.shinyreact.ReactDOM",
    },
  },
},
```

---

## What a registered component receives

```ts
interface RegisteredComponentProps {
  element: {
    type: "react";
    name: string;
    props: Record<string, unknown>;  // props from Python/R Node()
    children?: Element[];
  };
  children: ReactNode;  // pre-rendered children — use this, not element.children
}
```

---

## Hook reference

| Hook | Signature | Use when |
|------|-----------|----------|
| `useShinyInput` | `(id, default, opts?) → [value, setValue]` | Component reads and writes |
| `useShinyInputValue` | `(id) → value` | Read-only |
| `useSetShinyInput` | `(id, default, opts?) → setValue` | Write-only (buttons, events) |
| `useShinyOutputValue` | `(id, default?) → value` | Read server-computed data |
| `useShinyOutputStatus` | `(id) → "pending"\|"ready"\|"recalculating"\|"error"` | Stale-data UX |
| `useShinyMessageHandler` | `(type, handler)` | Push events from server |
| `useShinyInitialized` | `() → boolean` | Gate render until Shiny ready |
| `useShinyBusy` | `() → boolean` | App-wide busy indicator |

Key options for `useShinyInput`/`useSetShinyInput`: `debounceMs` (default 100; use `0` for buttons), `priority: "event"` (for buttons), `type` (server-side input handler name).

Import all hooks from one place:
```js
// src/hooks.js
export const { useShinyInput, useShinyInputValue, ... } = window.shinyreact;
```

---

## Python API quick reference

| Function | Pattern | Returns |
|----------|---------|---------|
| `Node(type, props, children)` | both | wire-tree builder |
| `output_react(id, extra_deps)` | app.py | `<div>` placeholder |
| `page_react(*args, title, lang)` | app.py | full page `Tag` |
| `page_react_dep(js_file, css_file)` | both | `HTMLDependency` |
| `@render_react` | app.py | `Renderer[Node\|TagChild]` |
| `@reactive_output` | ui.tsx | `Renderer[Jsonifiable]` |
| `send_message(session, type, data)` | both | `Awaitable` |
| `set_react_page(path)` | ui.tsx (Express) | `None` |

---

## R API quick reference

| Function | Pattern | Returns |
|----------|---------|---------|
| `node(type, ..., props)` | both | `shinyreact_node` (Tagifiable) |
| `output_react(id, extra_deps)` | app.R | `shiny.tag` `<div>` |
| `page_react(..., title, lang)` | app.R | `shiny.tag` page |
| `page_react_dep(src_dir, js_file, css_file, name)` | both | `htmlDependency` |
| `render_react(expr)` assigned to `output$id` | app.R | render function |
| `reactive_output(expr)` assigned to `output$id` | ui.tsx | render function |
| `send_message(session, type, data)` | both | invisible |
| `page_react_html(path)` | ui.tsx | `tagList` UI |

R shape differences from Python: children are `...` args (not a `children=` list); `page_react_html()` = Python's `set_react_page()`; `page_react_dep()` takes explicit `src_dir`.
